<BEGIN_SHACL>
@prefix nltl: <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#> .
@prefix sh: <http://www.w3.org/ns/shacl#> .
@prefix qudt: <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/> .
@prefix qudtunit: <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/> .
@prefix xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#> .

nltl:UpperIceWaterlineDisplacementShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:in ( qudtunit:KiloTON_Metric ) ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] .

nltl:WaterlineCaseDisplacementShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class qudt:QuantityValue ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:numericValue ;
        sh:datatype xsd:decimal ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path qudt:unit ;
        sh:in ( qudtunit:KiloTON_Metric ) ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] .

nltl:UpperIceWaterlineCaseShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:class nltl:upperIceWaterlineCase ;
    sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:waterlineCaseDisplacement ;
        sh:node nltl:WaterlineCaseDisplacementShape ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] .

nltl:ShipUpperIceWaterlineDisplacementShape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass nltl:ship ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:hasUpperIceWaterlineCase ;
        sh:node nltl:UpperIceWaterlineCaseShape ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] ;
    sh:property [
        sh:path nltl:upperIceWaterlineDisplacement ;
        sh:node nltl:UpperIceWaterlineDisplacementShape ;
        sh:nodeKind sh:IRI ;
        sh:minCount 1
    ] ;
    sh:prefixes [
        sh:declare [
            sh:prefix "nltl" ;
            sh:namespace "https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#"
        ] ;
        sh:declare [
            sh:prefix "qudt" ;
            sh:namespace "http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/"
        ] ;
        sh:declare [
            sh:prefix "qudtunit" ;
            sh:namespace "http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/"
        ]
    ] ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "The upper ice waterline displacement must equal the greatest represented waterline case displacement, with all quantities expressed in canonical kilotonnes." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT DISTINCT $this
            WHERE {
                $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#upperIceWaterlineDisplacement> ?resultQuantity .
                ?resultQuantity
                    <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?resultValue ;
                    <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit>
                        <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .

                {
                    FILTER EXISTS {
                        $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase> ?case .
                        ?case <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement> ?caseQuantity .
                        ?caseQuantity
                            <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?caseValue ;
                            <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit>
                                <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?caseValue > ?resultValue)
                    }
                }
                UNION
                {
                    FILTER NOT EXISTS {
                        $this <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#hasUpperIceWaterlineCase> ?equalCase .
                        ?equalCase <https://w3id.org/nltl/vocab#waterlineCaseDisplacement> ?equalQuantity .
                        ?equalQuantity
                            <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/numericValue> ?equalValue ;
                            <http://qudt.org/schema/qudt/unit>
                                <http://qudt.org/vocab/unit/KiloTON_Metric> .
                        FILTER (?equalValue = ?resultValue)
                    }
                }
            }
        """
    ] .
<END_SHACL>
